authority.summary: Owner instructed Project Leader to finish in-scope PINK VPN 10-slot and autonomous slot reuse work. First guarded backend deployment run 37962668923 failed after successful complete pgdump, backup and rollback timer but before source-install completion; failed attempt was restored by PINK081_OLD_APP_AND_SCHEMA_EXACTLY_RESTORED=PASS. Exact read-only CI 37963537319 proved old backend hash and 0002 revision still intact, previous backups/source retained, timer active, effective quota10 and healthy services. Same CI proved the pinned PINK code includes two nested source directories and the original installer incorrectly asserted all rglob('*') nodes were Python files. Corrected installer selects rglob('*.py') with nested-module install test, created selective retry-safe rollback, and added bounded phase diagnostics. R2 first verifies original state, safely retires only the completed old rollback timer, then archives previous root-only backup and pinned source unchanged before starting its own new protected backup and independent 15m rollback timer; read-only proof must run again on R2 exact head. The live operation is limited to previously tested Python app modules plus four additive Alembic revisions through 0006; existing VPN keys, installation ownership, WireGuard service/peers, IPTV mappings, quota10, firewall, secrets and all client APKs stay preserved. New code cannot be accepted without exact SQL lease fingerprint equality, recovery routes, health, observed quota and independent certified workflow. Prior PR62 PostgreSQL fixture migration CI passed/merged. No Android signing/installation or public release is authorized.
